toll_washing_rates.note: Toll washing rates are not publicly published and are negotiated commercially. These are indicative market estimates based on industry knowledge and coal sector economics. Rates are heavily influenced by yield (% product recovery from ROM feed), haul distance, rail access, and contract tenure. Plants with rail siding access can typically command a premium or discount logistics costs to attract volume.
toll_washing_rates.contract_structure: Typically structured as a fixed rate per ROM tonne fed or per product tonne produced, plus variable charges for magnetite consumption. Longer-term contracts (12â€“36 months) attract lower rates; spot/short-term processing at market premium.

data.why_DMS_is_the_preferred_technology: DMS using magnetite provides the most precise specific gravity-based separation, delivering consistent product ash and calorific value regardless of seam variability. For export coal production, DMS cyclone plants achieve the tightest cut-point control compared to jigs or spirals, maximising product yield at specification while minimising yield loss to discard. Dual-module DMS configurations (like Veralogix Plant's) provide redundancy and the ability to process different size fractions (coarse and fine) in parallel, improving overall recovery.
